items.title: PE's £150B decade-long UK stock market binge in one chart
items.summary: Private equity has agreed £25.1 billion (around $33 billion) of London take-privates this year—up from £14.3 billion last year—as ever larger funds turn to discounted UK plc to deploy their capital. In all, 11 deals have been agreed this year; five of them, worth £2.3 billion, have completed. The other £22.8 billion comprises six pending deals; among them are EQT’s Intertek deal at £10.9 billion and Apollo Global Management’s planned easyJet purchase at £5.7 billion. While tech high-flyers wobble, short-duration investment-grade corporate bond funds can look like a calm harbor.
